evidence: Both dist wrappers select scripts/relkit-local.ts for the disposable external cwd; that launcher ultimately spawns this exact native local.ts dev entry.
Direct native entry preserves command dev and explicit ports but bypasses wrapper/watcher intermediaries, so cliPid is the server authority's actual native CLI receipt.
